posts.title: Context Engineering from the Inside Out
posts.description: AI agents live and die by their context windows. The system prompt, tool schemas, conversation history, retrieved documents — everything the model sees during a single request shapes what it does next. posts.title: GPT-OSS Inference from Scratch
posts.description: In this post, we implement GPT-OSS-20B inference from scratch in PyTorch.
